source.note: Pairwise witness of the dice-rolled EMIT -> dice-rolled CONSUME edge (the DiceToTrigger flow arm, CR 706.2): a 'roll N dice' emit refuels a 'whenever you roll one or more dice' trigger. Pair o' Dice Lost ('Roll two six-sided dice. ...') projects emit:rolldice:controlled (family=dice, stem=dice, tier=Green, isSelf=false, oracleLineIndex 0) -> ADR-3 stem dice-rolled, control=you. Brazen Dwarf ('Whenever you roll one or more dice, ...') projects trigger:rolldice:controlled (family=dice, stem=dice, tier=Green) -> the dice-rolled subscription, control=you, a BARE any-roll (no result qualifier). Both ports AST-derivable in the current parser (verified via dumps/card-ports.json). This is the emit-side witness of dice-rolled (brazen-dwarf.json witnessed only the consume side); the edge is the You<->You roller-scope match. NOT a closed loop: Pair o' Dice Lost rolls once and exiles itself, and no derivable card RE-rolls on a roll, so a pure-dice self-feeding engine cannot be closed as a combo today (see the no_loop assertion + the parse-gap note in the batch report). No edhrec_rank / popularity in the testbed source for this pair -- popularity omitted (not fabricated).

judge.ref: ij 2026-07-17 b6 — dice->dice GREEN CR-GUARANTEED (You subsumes You, bare any-roll, no threshold); PROCEED

Pair o' Dice Lost.note: THE ROLLER (emit-side witness) -- 'Roll two six-sided dice' -- an unconditional roll emit on the bare EVENT verb dice-rolled. ADR-2 label emit:rolldice:controlled; the 'controlled' segment maps to the control axis value 'you' (you roll). AST-derivable: family=dice, stem=dice, tier=Green, isSelf=false. Rolls two dice (>= one), satisfying a 'one or more dice' watch; qty omitted (the label carries no count and the trigger is any-qty, so it does not narrow the match).

incidental one-shot context -- 'Return any number of cards ... from your graveyard to your hand' (emit:returntohand:card). The roll's payoff, not the witness. Establishes Pair o' Dice Lost as a one-shot value spell, not a repeatable roller.

Brazen Dwarf.note: THE SUBSCRIPTION -- 'whenever you roll one or more dice' -- a player-action subscription on the bare EVENT verb dice-rolled (trigger:rolldice:controlled -> control=you, the roller's scope). A BARE any-roll trigger: no DieResultThreshold / result facet, so nothing narrows the watched-roll filter. Identical port to brazen-dwarf.json B0.

incidental roll payoff -- 'this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent' (emit:damage:noncombat:opponent, isSelf=true). damage-dealt already witnessed by ancient-copper-dragon / brazen-dwarf; this damage does NOT roll dice, so it cannot re-drive B0 -- the pairwise stays acyclic.

notes: The DiceToTrigger arm (CR 706.2): a 'roll N dice' emit refuels a 'whenever you roll one or more dice' trigger. Stems equal (dice-rolled = dice-rolled).

Roller-scope match on the CONTROL axis: emit control=you is provably subsumed by the subscription's watched scope control=you (you subset-eq you) -> Subsumes -> GREEN. This REUSES policy:subscription:subject-subsumes-green (confirmed via ruthless-knave over the creature-subtype axis), generalizing it to the control/roller axis -- the axis is a port attr; the subscription-subsumption tiering is axis-agnostic.

GREEN is honest because Brazen Dwarf is a BARE any-roll subscription (no result-threshold facet). A 'whenever you roll a [specific result]' trigger would narrow the filter so the emit no longer provably subsumes it -> AMBER via section 8 firability (not witnessed here; Pair o' Dice Lost x Brazen Dwarf is the no-threshold GREEN branch).

assertions.because: P0 projects the bare EVENT verb dice-rolled on the EMIT (roller) side ('Roll two six-sided dice') -- brazen-dwarf.json witnessed only the consume side; this turns the emit side of dice-rolled from predicted to witnessed
dice-rolled emit -> dice-rolled subscription is the DiceToTrigger arm; the roller-scope subsumption is certified by the reused subscription policy, not a structural stem-cover alone
roller scope control=you subset-eq control=you (Subsumes) AND B0 is a bare any-roll subscription with no result-threshold facet -> clean subsumption -> GREEN (You<->You)
the subscription-subsumption GREEN branch (confirmed by ruthless-knave-x-blood-artist) governs the roller-scope match over the control axis; reused, not re-declared

unit=pairwise: Pair o' Dice Lost rolls once and exiles itself (P1 one-shot), and Brazen Dwarf's payoff (B1 damage-dealt) does not roll dice, so no cycle closes. A self-feeding roll engine needs a re-roll payoff no derivable card provides today -- left for when a re-roller parses (parse gap: Swarming Goblins' ETB roll no longer projects emit:rolldice)
